clue.text: Gasp, having a cold, turning over in sleep

indicators.note: turning over means the gasp-plus-a-cold string is read from the back

parts.note: to gasp is to pant
C is the standard abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: Someone gasps and splutters with a cold while tossing and turning in bed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning over' reverses PANTAC, built from PANT, A and C.
explanation.definitionFit: A short light nap taken during the day is a brief spell of sleep.

clue.text: Do a meal, possibly stewed with veg?

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters of the opening words may be arranged another way

explanation.surface: Cooking a meal, perhaps a stew with vegetables on the side.
explanation.walkthrough: In French cookery boeuf a la mode is beef braised with vegetables, hence the questioning definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The French culinary phrase describes beef braised slowly in wine alongside vegetables, so the definition is an example.

clue.text: President offering nothing, nothing, nothing initially

parts.note: nix is slang for nothing
O, the figure zero, means nothing

indicators.note: initially tells us to take only the opening letter of the third nothing

explanation.surface: A head of state who has nothing at all to say for himself.
explanation.definitionFit: Richard Nixon was the thirty-seventh holder of the top office in the United States.

clue.text: A pony's transformed with lei — in this Pacific region?

indicators.note: transformed says the letters of a pony's and lei are made into something new

explanation.surface: A pony decked out in a flower garland, as if on a tropical island.
explanation.walkthrough: A lei is a Hawaiian flower garland, fitting the island scene.
explanation.definitionFit: The name covers the great triangle of islands in the central and southern Pacific Ocean, including Hawaii.

clue.text: What's wonderful about short love affair? It's puzzling

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the word for wonderful is read backwards

parts.note: fab is informal for wonderful
a fling is a brief romance

explanation.surface: Someone baffled by a brief romance that seemed wonderful.
explanation.definitionFit: Something baffling is bewildering and hard to understand, which is a synonym of puzzling.

clue.text: Prejudiced educationist, one idiot to be shut up

indicators.note: to be shut up means enclosed, so these pieces are placed inside the educationist's letters

parts.note: a BEd is a Bachelor of Education degree, held by a teacher
I is the Roman numeral one
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: A biased teacher who thinks a fool ought to be silenced.
explanation.walkthrough: BEd is the British teaching degree; I and ASS go inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone prejudiced is unfairly partial, the same as being biased (a British spelling with double S).

clue.text: Entrance area for receiving you

indicators.note: receiving means the word for takes the other piece within it

parts.note: ye is an old form of you

explanation.surface: A hotel lobby set aside for welcoming guests.
explanation.definitionFit: A foyer is the entrance hall or lobby of a theatre or hotel.

clue.text: Be idle, offering story before a whole lot of drinks

indicators.note: before places the story's word ahead of the rest

parts.note: a story can mean a lie, a fib
a round is a set of drinks bought for everyone in a group

explanation.surface: Someone lazily telling tales before buying everyone a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: To loaf about doing nothing useful is to be idle; the phrasal verb is a synonym.

clue.text: Clouds unable to move disperse finally

indicators.note: to move tells us the letters of unable are shifted around
finally takes the closing letter of disperse

explanation.surface: Clouds that cannot move until they eventually break up.
explanation.definitionFit: Nebulae are vast interstellar clouds of gas and dust seen in astronomy.

clue.text: Have to be seen as one in the grammar class?

definitions.text: Have to be seen as one in the grammar class?

parts.words: Have to be seen as one in the grammar class?
parts.note: the word have, seen as a grammar term, is a helping verb used to form tenses, a classroom category

explanation.surface: A pupil told they must be seen as one of the grammar school set.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Have' looks like 'must' but is the word itself, which grammar classifies as a helper verb.
explanation.definitionFit: Grammar classes helping words such as have, be and do, which form tenses, in this category.

clue.text: Male snoring terribly — more than once when he should be getting up?

definitions.text: more than once when he should be getting up?

indicators.note: terribly signals that snoring is badly jumbled

explanation.surface: A man snoring dreadfully when he ought to be rising.
explanation.definitionFit: The plural of the early part of the day, when people wake, so more than one such time.

clue.text: Artist and count meeting very infrequently

parts.note: RA, Royal Academician, is a common abbreviation for an artist
to count on is to rely on

explanation.surface: A painter and a nobleman who seldom get together.
explanation.walkthrough: 'count' suggests an earl but is the verb, as in counting on someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Something done seldom happens hardly ever, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Scenes from another world packed with energy

indicators.note: packed with means the planet's name holds the other piece inside

parts.note: Venus is a planet, another world from ours
E is the symbol for energy in physics

explanation.surface: Pictures of an alien planet bursting with vitality.
explanation.definitionFit: Venues are the places where events happen, as the scene of an action is its setting.

clue.text: Lunch I ate turned out to be bad

indicators.note: turned out suggests the letters of lunch I ate are turned into a fresh order

explanation.surface: A diner reports that the meal eaten proved to be off.
explanation.definitionFit: Conduct that is morally wrong or improper is bad in the ethical sense.

clue.text: Unendingly dedicated Socialist gets destroyed

indicators.note: unendingly tells us to cut off the final letter of the word for dedicated

parts.note: devout means piously dedicated
red is a common term for a socialist or communist

explanation.surface: A committed left-winger is ruined.
explanation.definitionFit: To devour is to consume completely, so devoured is a figurative synonym of destroyed.

clue.text: Relatives surprisingly willing to fit in?

indicators.note: surprisingly hints the letters of relatives turn up in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: Family members unexpectedly eager to blend in.
explanation.definitionFit: An adaptable, all-round person can adjust to many roles, so is ready to slot in anywhere.

clue.text: An Oxford connection?

parts.note: an Oxford is a style of laced shoe, so what ties it is a lace for footwear, not a link to the university

explanation.surface: Someone with ties to the university city.
explanation.walkthrough: Oxford suggests the university; here it is the Oxford shoe, a lace-up style.
explanation.definitionFit: A cord that ties an Oxford shoe is literally what connects or fastens it.

clue.text: Dynasty no longer existing in foreign city

definitions.meaning: the German royal house that ruled Britain from George I to Victoria, now ended
a city in Lower Saxony, Germany

explanation.surface: A vanished ruling family once based abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: The name of a defunct British royal house and of a German city of the same name.

clue.text: Eastern maiden pursued by journalists, one married to ruler?

indicators.note: pursued by puts the journalists after the first pieces

parts.note: M is the cricket scorecard abbreviation for a maiden over
the press is the collective term for journalists

explanation.surface: A young woman from the East chased by reporters.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a maiden is an over with no runs, written M.
explanation.definitionFit: An emperor's wife bears the female title, so she is a consort of the ruler.

clue.text: Journeys taking in good long stretches high up

indicators.note: taking in means the journeys word contains the other piece

parts.note: rides are journeys on horseback or in vehicles

explanation.surface: Hikes that include fine stretches of high ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Ridges are long narrow elevated crests of hills or mountains.

clue.text: Aroused old lover gets named

parts.note: an ex is a former partner
cited means mentioned by name

explanation.surface: A former partner gets roused on being identified.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone stirred up or stimulated is excited, a synonym.

clue.text: One goes to bed, dropping down heavily

definitions.text: One goes to bed, dropping down heavily

parts.words: One goes to bed, dropping down heavily
parts.note: a heavy ship's mooring weight is dropped and sinks to the sea bed, not a bedroom

explanation.surface: A tired person flopping exhaustedly into bed.
explanation.walkthrough: The bed is the sea bed, where a ship's weight is dropped.
explanation.definitionFit: The heavy iron hook a vessel lowers sinks to rest on the seabed to hold the ship.

clue.text: City's farewell message — refusal to be upset

definitions.note: the definition is City; the 's is is, a link

parts.note: RIP, rest in peace, is a farewell on gravestones

indicators.note: upset here means turned over, so the word for refusal is read backwards

parts.note: no is a refusal

explanation.surface: A town's goodbye note turns out to be an angry refusal.
explanation.walkthrough: Ripon is a cathedral city in North Yorkshire, England.
explanation.definitionFit: Ripon in North Yorkshire holds city status thanks to its cathedral.

clue.text: What makes perfect performance — sacrifice all round

indicators.note: all round means the sacrifice word goes around the other piece

parts.note: a price is what must be given up, a sacrifice
an act is a performance

explanation.surface: A flawless performance that cost great sacrifice.
explanation.definitionFit: The proverb says repeated rehearsal leads to flawlessness, so the definition quotes it.

clue.text: English article thanks character from Greece

parts.note: the is the English definite article
ta is British informal thanks

explanation.surface: An English piece of writing thanks a Greek figure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'character' suggests a person but means a letter of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: Theta is the eighth letter of the Greek alphabet, a written symbol or character.

clue.text: High-up executive officer pens directive after negotiation

indicators.note: after negotiation suggests the letters of pens directive have been bargained into a new form

explanation.surface: A senior executive writes an order once talks are done.
explanation.definitionFit: The deputy to a president is a senior officer of a company or state.

clue.text: Professional is desperate and keeps going

parts.note: pro is short for professional
longs means yearns or is desperate for something

explanation.surface: An expert who is anxious yet carries on regardless.
explanation.definitionFit: To extend something in time is to make it continue, so keeps going in the transitive sense.

clue.text: Animals dash — first signs of dry season

parts.note: elan is flair or dash

indicators.note: first signs of takes the opening letters of dry and season

explanation.surface: Wildlife rushing off at the start of the dry season.
explanation.definitionFit: Elands are large African antelopes, so examples of animals.
